environment.description: ECS Fargate service in us-east-1 VPC (10.0.0.0/16). The Kafka broker is Amazon MSK accessible within the VPC. The service's port 8080 is exposed via an internal ALB with no authentication. Any service within the VPC (or peered VPCs) can reach the /debug/render endpoint. Environment variables ADMIN_SECRET, DB_PASSWORD, and INTERNAL_API_KEY are injected from Secrets Manager. No input validation or template sandboxing is applied.

config.network: VPC 10.0.0.0/16, internal ALB on port 8080, security group allows inbound from 10.0.0.0/16
config.kafka: Amazon MSK cluster in same VPC, IAM auth for producers
config.secrets: AWS Secrets Manager values injected as env vars
config.access: Any VPC-internal client can reach /debug/render and produce to Kafka topic
